messages:
maya: quick brain dump: product wants the Console to warn users when their embeddings payloads are likely to hit transport or billing limits. thought: add a tiny preflight hint that shows estimated 'billing units' (dims-derived) and payload bytes, plus a one-click suggestion to split.
cheng: love that. We already compute dim & byte stats in the ingestion path. Two implementation options: (A) Console calls a preflight endpoint that mirrors ingress math, or (B) Console approximates in-browser. I prefer (A) to guarantee parity.
olivia: agree on preflight endpoint. Key UX details: primary line must be extremely short (e.g., 'Est: 1.9k units · 6.2 KB — Suggest 3 parts') and an expandable section with exact math and a curl example. For mixed vector lengths show 'mixed dims' and recommend client-side chunking.
kevin: telemetry: emit events preflight.hint_shown (dims,size,model_route,tenant) and preflight.hint_accepted. Also track preflight.request_latency and preflight.error_rate for SLOs. Expose per-route %hint_shown and %hint_applied in the route dashboard.
maya: endpoint design: POST /v1/embeddings/preflight with identical schema but only run estimator. Return 200 JSON with {"dims_est":...,"bytes":...,"suggested_splits":...} or 204 with headers for super-lightweight clients. Need rate-limits and a header to opt-in so we don't compute for every console keystroke.
cheng: implement server-side flag embed_preflight_console so we can gate rollout. runtime: reuse splitter logic for suggested_splits. Important to return a 'confidence' field when mixed dims or variable sizes so UI knows to be conservative.
olivia: UX toggle: 'Auto preflight' setting in Console (off by default). Console should call preflight on paste/file upload or when user clicks preview. If mixed dims, show sample chunking snippet and a link to docs.
kevin: testing: add unit tests to ensure preflight estimator matches billing math (tokenization/rounding rules). Otherwise support will see charge mismatches.
maya: rollout plan: feature-flagged UI + endpoint; telemetry enabled immediately. Canary 5% tenants -> 25% -> 100% over two weeks. deploy-bot: canary job started by cheng: embed_preflight_console flag enabled for 5% tenants.
cheng: action items: add endpoint + flag + rate-limits + telemetry hooks. olivia: design small card and details pane. kevin: telemetry spec and dashboard queries. maya: docs/snippet and support blurb. sync tomorrow at 10:30. :thumbsup:
